title: Agent Report Approval Inbox Ingest Authority

supporting_authority.ref: .vibepro/stories/story-brainbase-agent-report-approval-inbox/spec.md#契約拡張唯一のサーバー変更

responsibilities.unknown_policy: agent_report runs are approval-only ingest runs (implementation_key external-runner:agent_report) with no executable runner handler. They MUST be closed by resolveHumanStep's approval-only special-case (isApprovalOnlyIngestWorkflow), never dispatched through the generic runWorkflow fallback, to avoid orphan needs_action runs. The eve runner (external-runner:eve) is explicitly excluded and retains its registered resume handler. Owner/approver ids on ingested agent_report payloads default to sato_keigo and are validated by the existing runner-type-agnostic delegation guards in server/routes/external-runner.js; they are never accepted as delegated authority for a different person.
